# light_gem.gd

[Source:1](../../../light_gem.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Samples two rendered views for player illumination. raw_value is the brightest
opaque quadrant average; value is calibration_curve.sample(raw_value).
Requires both viewports and a calibration curve; headless runs keep prior values.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `LightGem`.

### sample_viewport

```gdscript
func sample_viewport(viewport) -> float
```

[Source:37](../../../light_gem.gd#L37)

### classify

```gdscript
func classify(x, y, N) -> int
```

[Source:68](../../../light_gem.gd#L68)
